theorem MemoryStorage.Entries.window (M : GMap Nat EntryM) (c : Nat) (ents ab : List EntryM) (k lo
    hi : Nat) (Hab : ∀ (j : Nat) (e : EntryM), ab[j]? = some e → M !! (k + j) = some e) (Hend : ∀ (i
    : Nat), c + 1 + ents.length ≤ i → M !! i = none) (Hmid : ∀ (i : Nat), c < i → i < c + 1 +
    ents.length → M !! i = ents[i - c - 1]?) (Hk : k ≤ lo) (Hlohi : lo < hi) (Hhi : hi ≤ k +
    ab.length) (Hc : c < lo) : hi ≤ c + 1 + ents.length ∧ List.drop (lo - c - 1) (List.take (hi - c
    - 1) ents) = List.take (hi - lo) (List.drop (lo - k) ab)

theorem MemoryStorage.Entries.ownSlice_same_ptr_len [package_sem : Assumptions] {V : Type} [ZeroVal
    V] [TypedPointsto V] (s1 s2 : GoSlice) (dq : DFrac) (vs : List V) : vs ≠ [] → s1.ptr = s2.ptr →
    s1.len = s2.len → sint.Z s2.len ≤ sint.Z s2.cap → ⊢ ownSlice s1 vs dq -∗ ownSlice s2 vs dq
